scope: Each exported Sercos III parameter individually reviewed for type/unit/source/edition/bounds/default/applicability and dependencies, industry-neutral path. Foreign technology evidence cannot certify it.

Protocol minimum cycle31.25us versus Hilscher master minimum250us, explicitly selected source proposals; no overwrite of actual commissioned cycles or auto-confirmation. 100M/full/0x88CD are conditional reference proposals.
MDT/AT regions, connections, 40..1494 data bytes, 44 bytes management/physical occupation, cycle aggregate, measured ring delay and guards distinguished. Exact 6.72us differs brochure rounded6.8us.
RTC and independently bound UCC have separate slots/protocols. Actual UCC MTU46..1500 under Hilscher and window fit, no unverified576-byte factory default.

CP3 invalid/zero process data cannot pass operational acceptance. CP4 phase/producer readiness, mapping, clock, full schedule, actual losses and complete source/network/consumer/age evidence are independent requirements.
Safety container requires independent safety case, not capacity alone. No hardware executor or full IEC certification inferred; runtime MODEL_MISSING remains explicit.
779 isolated tests PASS, 162 native andnine shared suites.
